question: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana was launched in _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) **was launched on** 25 September 2014.**
 
• **DDU-GKY** was launched by **Union Ministers Nitin Gadkari **and** Venkaiah Naidu **on the occasion of the** 98th birth anniversary of Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya.**
 
• The Vision of DDU-GKY is to **skill rural youth** who are poor and provide them with jobs having regular monthly wages or above the minimum wages.
 
• DDU-GKY aims to target youth, in the **age group of 15–35 years.**
 
• DDU-GKY is one of the clusters of initiatives of the **Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. **
 
• DDU-GKY is a part of the **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)- the Mission for poverty reduction called Aajeevika.**
